params.body:
## Why

On 1 October 2026 a StockCars user received the daily worklist mail ("StockCars - Heads-up! Er is actie nodig in je werklijsten.", title "Oeps!", lines "Leads 1" and "Transport 2", button "Naar de werklijsten") and found no transports on the worklist page.

The mail counted per garage and sent every recipient to `/worklists`. That page shows only the lists the user switched on in "Weergave werklijsten aanpassen" (`Auth::user()->widgets`), so anyone with the transport list switched off read "Transport 2" and found nothing. The same was true of the other four lines. On top of that, the transport line checked only the BEHEERDER role and never the garage's transport switch (#863), and the Car-Pass line was titled "Onvolledige voertuigen".

## What changes

**Lines are decided per recipient** (`App\Support\WorklistDigest::lines`). A line is in the mail only when the recipient may open the page it links to:

| Line (most urgent first) | Link | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| Untreated leads | `/worklists?show=4#widget_4` | role sees menu `worklists` |
| Car-Passes due for renewal | `/worklists?show=2#widget_2` | role sees menu `worklists` |
| Open transports | `/transports` (`transport.index`) | garage `transport_enabled` and the `use-transport` Gate |
| Unfinished vehicles | `/worklists?show=1#widget_1` | role sees menu `worklists` |
| Unread release notes | `/worklists?show=3#widget_3` | role sees menu `worklists` |

The rights check is the same one the Access middleware runs (`AccessRights::forUser`, plus the Gate for transport). A recipient who is left with no lines gets no mail.

**Leads, Car-Passes, unfinished vehicles and release notes have no page of their own.** The worklist page is the only place they are listed, and own stock has no "incomplete" filter. So `WorklistController::index` now accepts `?show=<widget>`: the page renders that list even when the user switched it off. It goes first, and on a phone it opens unfolded. The user's own choice is not changed. Widget 5 (transport) is added this way only for someone who passes the transport Gate (`WidgetService::pageWidgets`). Transports link to the transport overview, which lists them regardless of widgets.

**Garages with open transports but the transport switch off:** no mail carries those transports. Instead the command writes one warning per garage per run: `Worklist mail: garage <id> (<name>) has N open transport(s) but its transport switch is off; left out of the mail.` These are garages that still have transports from before #863 made transport a per-garage switch. The office can either switch transport on for them or close those transports.

**Button.** "Naar de werklijsten" is gone. With every line linking to its own list, that button led to the page that caused the problem: it shows whatever the user switched on, not what the mail is about. The mail now has one primary button that opens the first and most urgent line, with a label for that kind ("Naar de aanvragen", "Naar de transporten", ...). Urgency order: a customer waiting for an answer, then a Car-Pass that renews automatically within the week with the mileage as it stands, then transports, then incomplete records, then release notes.

**Copy**, in nl, fr, en, de and es through `resources/lang/*/email.php` (`worklist_mail_*`, replacing `open_worklist_items_*`):
- subject `<Garage>: 3 dingen wachten op je`, singular `<Garage>: 1 ding wacht op je`. The count is the sum of the lines in the body, so the subject never promises more than the mail shows
- heading `Dit wacht op je`
- one linked sentence per line: `1 aanvraag die nog niet behandeld is`, `2 transporten die op je wachten`, `4 wagens met een onvolledige fiche`, ...
- no "Oeps!", no "Heads-up!", no exclamation marks, no middots, no em dashes, no emoji. The Spanish file used to carry the Dutch text and now has Spanish

The mail keeps the house layout (`mail::message`, `mail::button` in the `stocklist` colour). `stocklist:mail-preview` now uses the new sample data.

## Rules

- R P1-2.11 and R P1-2.12 have been rewritten for the per-recipient lines, the links, the button and the subject count. R S3-5.8 now mentions the Car-Pass link.
- New rule R P1-2.20 covers `?show=` on the worklist page.
- New finding `bevinding: werklijstmail-belooft-wat-de-werklijst-niet-toont`, status opgelost.

## Not changed, for a decision

- Which garages are selected (`DealerRepository::getAllWithWorklistItems`) stays the same. A garage with only open transports is still not selected (as R P1-2.12 already said).
- `where('dealer_group_id', '!=', 14)` also drops every garage whose `dealer_group_id` is NULL, because SQL `NULL != 14` is not true. The rule says "buiten dealergroep 14". If some garages have no group, they never get this mail. Not changed here; worth one count on production.
- Transports are now shown to every user of a garage that has the switch on, not only to BEHEERDER users. That matches who can open `/transports` (the Gate decides, R S4-10.18).
- Found while writing the tests: the leads list on the worklist page (`worklist/widgets/4.blade.php`) and the transport overview (`settings/transport/index.blade.php`, also `worklist/widgets/5.blade.php`) throw a 500 for a lead or transport without `vehicle_id`, because `route()` gets a missing parameter. Not touched here; in production every lead and transport may well carry a vehicle.

## Tests

`tests/Feature/WorklistMailTest.php` (Mail::fake, nothing sent):
- a user with no list switched on still gets a transport line, and its link opens (200) as that user
- every line, for all five kinds, links to a named route that opens (200) for that user, and the asked list is on the page and open
- a garage without the transport switch gets no transport line, and exactly one warning for that garage
- a role without the worklists right gets only transports, and gets no mail once transports are off as well
- the subject count equals the sum of the lines, in the singular and the plural
- a French user gets French subject, heading, lines and button
- the copy in every language has no exclamation, "Oeps", "Heads-up", middot, em dash or emoji
- `/worklists?show=4` shows the leads list that is switched off, and `?show=5` without the Gate does not

Run locally: the full suite, PHPStan (baseline lowered: three `OpenWorklistItemsEmail` entries removed, one `WorklistController` count from 2 to 1), and pint on the new files.

Rendered sample (nl, three lines) looked at in a browser: heading, three linked sentences, one button.
params.title: Worklist mail: link each line to where it is listed, for that user
